Feves au Lard

Recipe

  1. 12 hours before, desalt the lard. soak the white beans with 2 tbsp baking soda.
  2. In a pan, brown :
    • 1 tbsp cooking oil or butter
    • 1 [[Onion]], chopped
    • 250 g [[Lard]]
  3. Transfert to a pressure cooker, dutch oven or crock pot, and add :
    • 4 [[Garlic]] cloves, finely chopped
    • 2 cups [[White Bean]], soaked overnight
    • 1 tbsp [[Dried Mustard]]
    • 1 tbsp [[Brown Sugar]]
    • 1/4 tbsp [[Peper]]
    • 1/4 tbsp [[Curcuma]]
    • 1/2 tbsp [[Thyme]]
    • 1/4 tbsp [[Salt]] ( or miso at the end )
    • 2 tbsp [[Molasse]]
    • 1 tbsp [[Apple Cider Vinegar]]
    • 75 ml [[Tomato Paste]]
  4. Cover with water (around 1 Litter) and cook :
    1. With a Pressure Cooker, cover with water and cooked for 1 hour when on high pressure, then let it 1 hour on natural-release
    2. With a Dutch Oven,
    3. With a Crock Pot
  5. Add :
    • 2 tbsp [[Miso]]

Notes

  • Lard is important! Bacon can be added but cannot replace lard!
  • add 2 cups ( 1/2 whole ) butternut squash, small cubed
  • having half bean and half butternut squash/sweetpotatoe is way too sweet, got to try 1 part bean to 1/2 part sweet potatoe, i think i dont like the tast of butternut in this or it was just too much maybe? also lard is important, this has to be a fat savory meal.
